_comment: Reviewed side file for the CEO pack v2 sheet compiler (#2997). One entry per form: the version to write, the key renames for the 7 deepened forms (key table #3008 §3), the retry wording for the experience and level questions (the sheets carry no second-ask wording), the reviewer notes, and the recorded option keys for every number band (so a generated key never changes between runs). Slug stored values use themselves as the option key; the escape chip always uses "unknown".
